label: Planday
description: Read workforce metadata and trigger workflows on new or updated employees and shifts

operations.name: get_portal_info
operations.description: Read actual protected portal ID, name, company name, country and timezone. Child portals and aliases are not traversed.

operations.name: list_departments
operations.description: Read one department metadata page; department:read.

operations.name: get_employee_group
operations.description: Read exact employee group ID; employeegroup:read.

operations.name: list_employees
operations.description: Read active employee IDs and department/group/type bindings, omitting personal and special fields; employee:read.

operations.name: get_employee
operations.description: Read exact employee ID and business profile only; no custom/special fields; employee:read.

operations.name: list_department_employees
operations.description: Read a protected department first, then its documented unpaged employee-ID relation; no pagination query is invented. Maximum 500 IDs accepted locally.

operations.name: list_shifts
operations.description: Read one department-scoped scheduling page within a required local date window, at most 31 inclusive days; shift:read. No punchclock details, comments or costs.

operations.name: get_shift
operations.description: Read exact shift ID and independently verify returned department parent; shift:read.

operations.name: on_new_or_updated_employee
operations.description: Monitor active employee metadata; employee:read. Existing records form a baseline. Deactivations are excluded. Maximum 1,000 records per poll; narrow Modified After for larger portals.

operations.name: on_new_or_updated_shift
operations.description: Monitor shift metadata; shift:read. Existing records form a baseline. Deleted shifts are excluded. Maximum 1,000 records per poll; narrow Department or Modified After for larger schedules.
